title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + GH workflow for quality gating
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: add a per-prompt regression CI hook that runs eval-harness prompt sets on PRs touching prompts, model routing, or API behavior. This allows us to fail fast on prompt-level quality regressions and tie threshold violations to a clear remediation path.

What this PR does: adds a lightweight GH Actions workflow (.github/workflows/eval-harness-prompt-ci.yml) that triggers on PRs when files under eval-harness/prompt-sets/ or redwood-docs/prompts/ change, or if PR includes the label 'run-eval-harness'. The workflow runs a new CLI entrypoint (eval-harness run-gates) that computes per-prompt metrics (EM, BLEU fallback, answer-constraint checks) and compares them against configured gates in eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml.

Implementation summary: 
- New entrypoint: eval-harness/hooks/prompt_ci_hook.py (exposes `run_gates` wrapper used by GH Actions).
- Gate config: eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml - default thresholds for key prompt-sets (conservative defaults set; teams can override with repo-level .eval-gates.yaml).
- Workflow: .github/workflows/eval-harness-prompt-ci.yml with matrix for model variants (open-qa-small, open-qa-medium) and a fast lightweight runner mode that samples prompt subsets for quick feedback.
- Tests: eval-harness/tests/test_prompt_gating.py adds unit tests for gate evaluation logic and mocked CLI runs.
- Docs: docs/ci/prompt-gating.md with usage, how to override, and rollback guidance.

Checklist: 
- [x] add CLI hook and workflow
- [x] add gate config + defaults
- [x] unit tests with CI coverage
- [x] docs for devs and SREs
- [x] Linear/Jira linked

Commits summary: "Initial implementation of prompt CI hook and workflow"; "Add gate config and default thresholds"; "Unit tests and docs".

Files changed (high-level): 
- .github/workflows/eval-harness-prompt-ci.yml - new GH Actions workflow that calls eval-harness run-gates, posts annotations on failure, and uploads a small artifact with full eval results. 
- eval-harness/hooks/prompt_ci_hook.py - new script + small compatibility shim to run inside runner and local dev.
- eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml - default per-prompt set gates; includes descriptions and suggested remediation.
- eval-harness/tests/test_prompt_gating.py - pytest suite with mocked model outputs to exercise gating logic.
- docs/ci/prompt-gating.md - developer-facing doc with examples and failure triage steps.
- eval-harness/cli.py
- eval-harness/utils/metrics.py
- redwood-docs/prompts/README.md

Testing and CI: 
- Initial run hit a lint failure (flake8 on hook file), fixed by removing a large inline helper and splitting logic into two functions.
- Unit tests pass in CI matrix after fix.
- Workflow tested end-to-end using a forked repo and a small sample prompt-set; annotations show up in GH checks for failing prompts.

Review notes and rollout plan: 
- Default gates are intentionally conservative to reduce false positives; this PR includes clear instructions for teams to opt-in to stricter gates by adding a .eval-gates.yaml to their repo.
- Rollout: enable for redwood repo first (this PR), monitor false-positive rate for two weeks, then enable across SDK repos behind a feature flag label.

Related: ENG-2041 (Linear), SUP-9821 (Jira), previous gating work in eval-harness (see PRs: 312459, 400123).

Merge: squash merge after approvals and green CI.

review_comments: Miguel Torres: Left a few nits on the workflow (prefer using actions/cache for python deps) and suggested we limit matrix to two smallest model variants for the initial run.

Sofia Li: Questioned the default threshold for 'qa-exact-match' on customer-facing prompts; suggested lowering default to avoid noisy failures. Asha: lowered default and added guidance to docs on how to tighten gates.
Ben Carter: Noted a potential race in artifact upload when parallel matrix jobs run; suggested switching to per-job artifact names. Updated in second commit to include job index in artifact name.
release_notes: Add per-prompt eval-harness CI hook and GitHub Actions workflow for prompt-level regression gating. Teams can opt into stricter gates via .eval-gates.yaml. This introduces a new CI check that can fail PRs when prompt quality degrades against configured thresholds.
notes_for_oncall: If the GH Action begins to produce many false positives, add the label 'run-eval-harness' to opt-in or temporarily disable the workflow by removing triggers from the workflow file. Config lives in eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yaml and is repo-overridable.
examples_of_failure_annotation: Check failed: prompt 'password_help_v2' EM dropped from 0.92 -> 0.84 (threshold 0.90). See artifact: eval-results/prompt_password_help_v2.json
Check failed: prompt 'billing_summary' BLEU dropped below configured gate (was 0.46, threshold 0.50).
